title: Emergency Brake Response
description: Request emergency braking while moving, observe deceleration and examine conditions for a training reset.

steps.instruction: At standstill with doors confirmed closed, select P1 to begin a low-speed exercise.
Observe a moving speed of at least 1 km/h before demonstrating emergency braking.
Activate the separate emergency brake switch and observe the emergency indication.
Monitor the speedometer while emergency braking reduces train speed to standstill.
At standstill, select N as required by this teaching configuration.
Use the teaching cab’s emergency reset input and verify that the emergency indication clears.

learningObjective: Differentiate emergency from service braking and observe the emergency state through standstill.
operatingConditions: Reset steps apply only to this training configuration, not universal railway operating instructions.
expectedObservations: Speed decreases over time; emergency activation does not produce instantaneous standstill.
Emergency remains active until the modeled reset conditions are satisfied.
debriefQuestions: Why is emergency braking different from B1–B3 service braking?
Why must real-life recovery follow operator-specific procedures?
